summary: 57-year-old Denver man John N. Countryman found dead on the floor of Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park below the South Rim near Devil's Lookout; deputies found his abandoned vehicle near mile marker 10 on Oct 27, a sheriff's drone team spotted human remains on the canyon floor the morning of Oct 28, and a technical recovery operation brought the body up Oct 30; cause and manner of death under investigation by the Montrose County Coroner's Office.
location: Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park, South Rim near Devil's Lookout
notes: APPROXIMATE DATE — 2026-10-27 is the date deputies found the abandoned vehicle and the search began; when Countryman entered the canyon / died is not stated in sources. Timeline: vehicle + personal belongings found near Devil's Lookout ~5:30 p.m. Oct 27; MCSO drone team confirmed human remains on the canyon floor ~6:30 a.m. Oct 28; body recovered Oct 30; MCSO announced Nov 4; coroner confirmed identity Nov 5. Cause and manner of death under investigation as of Nov 6-7 reporting. MCSO Facebook post is the primary source per Fox News; no case number stated. Inserted by freshness sweep 2026-11-07.
